entities.name: Destruction of the Second Temple
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Roman destruction of the Second Temple in 70 CE under Titus, marking the end of sacrificial worship and the priesthood. This catastrophe transformed Judaism into a rabbinic, synagogue-centered religion and profoundly affected early Christianity.
